item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs Conditional Loan Commitment of up to $450 Million With Neros, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a conditional loan commitment of up to $450 million to Neros Inc., a U.S.-based developer and manufacturer of dual-use small unmanned aircraft systems.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Releases Fiscal Year 2026 Military Intelligence Program Budget
item.description: The War Department released the Military Intelligence Program appropriated top-line budget for fiscal year 2026. The total was $30.9 billion and is aligned to the National Defense Strategy.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations
